summary: Range Impact, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026, its indirect subsidiary Range Bluegrass Land, LLC terminated two option agreements with MRR CNG, LLC and Wicks Building LLC, each originally dated December 31, 2025. As consideration, the Company issued 654,434 shares to each counterparty (1,308,868 total) at $0.764 per share, the September 2026 VWAP; MRR's $500,000 subscription price was satisfied by an already-paid option fee. No board recommendation or advisor is named. These are unregistered private placements tied to contract terminations rather than a discrete special situation; watch dilution and further option unwind terms.
